main_reasons: Pre-revenue clinical-stage biotech: no product revenue and only zero/$0.3M collaboration revenue, so little room for revenue manipulation
Balance sheet is mostly cash and high-grade Level 2 investments ($108M); simple cost structure (R&D, G&A, stock comp)
Statements internally consistent: cash flow, equity rollforward and MD&A reconcile
KPMG unqualified opinion, auditor since 2020; no restatement, no material weakness, ICFR reported effective
Main judgmental areas are R&D/CRO accruals (accrued R&D only $0.9M against $32M external AlloNK spend) and related-party GC Cell agreements, both small and disclosed
Minor drafting sloppiness (duplicated disclosure-controls paragraph) and liquidity only into Q2 2027, but these are not misstatement signals
